exposure: Kangaroo Mother Care (KMC) duration and frequency
outcome: maternal stress (measured by Parental Stress Scale)
cohort: 200 mothers of preterm neonates admitted to the NICU, divided into KMC and control groups.
finding: Kangaroo Mother Care significantly reduced maternal stress scores in mothers of preterm neonates compared to standard NICU care, with longer and more frequent KMC sessions correlating with greater stress reduction.
